scope: Formatting and source-fidelity requirements compiled from accepted primary reading, decisions and ledgers for 1847–1850 batches 19–21. This draft creates no converter, transcript, corpus export or training data.

requirements.case: October 7 Sunday versus original Monday and October 4 inference
requirements.requirement: Preserve the assigned 7 October date together with the literal weekday conflict (7 October 1849 was Sunday, while the source says Monday) and contextual 8 October alternative. Do not derive an exact October 4 receipt from the next-Monday reasoning. Keep the Hooker enclosure and Henslow/Benefit Clubs material in their separate knowledge layers.

requirements.case: Former 1220 letter distinguished from current 1247 enclosure

requirements.case: Read, heard and planned publication states
requirements.requirement: Represent distinct knowledge states: a paper or letter copied/read, reports merely heard, and works still planned for future inspection. In particular, “From all I hear” about Somerville is not a reading witness, while Odart remains future. Do not collapse possession, hearing, reading and intended publication into one availability flag.

future_requirements: Preserve date alternatives, relative receipt language, within-letter timing, source identity, attributed voices, MathML fractions and prospective versus completed events at the listed locators.
Keep a former letter, current enclosure and later witness as separate source objects even when a body identifies their relationship.
Use graph direction response → antecedent only where the schema calls for a relation; knowledge, receipt and rendering fields have distinct meanings.
not_implemented_here: No converter, renderer, transcript, ledger, export or training behavior was changed or run.
This draft creates no new historical acceptance and remains provisional for root verification.

notes: Requirements derive from accepted root decisions and are future implementation constraints, not permission to revise accepted evidence.
